evidence: Spelling: extracted every unique word from instruction.md, hireops_rules.md and integration.md and reviewed the full list by hand (no spell-check module installed); no misspellings found. Only locale variation: instruction.md:12-13 uses British 'honour PORT' / 'honouring DB_PATH' while integration.md:8 'honoring DB_PATH' and hireops_rules.md:200 'Honor the supplied DB_PATH' use US spelling; both are correct words, not real errors (observation only). Non-ASCII characters: none in any of the three files. Doubled words (regex \b(\w+)\s+\1\b): none. Contamination grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|TBD|placeholder|<tag>|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|lorem|note to self across the three files: zero hits; the template's 'CHANGE_ME' line was fully replaced. Paths named are only the task-intended /app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, /api/health, /app/node_modules; no author-machine paths. No author asides or duplicated paragraphs. Contradiction sweep: (a) accounts in instruction.md:17 (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates, password Hireops!2026) exactly match seed users (10 users, same emails and roles) and hireops_rules.md:11 password; only one account list exists. (b) Seed path is /assets/seed_data.json in instruction.md:13, integration.md:6-7 and hireops_rules.md:205; single value. (c) Port 3000/PORT, /app/app.db/DB_PATH, health route, Express+SQLite, no package install, CDN allowed for browser, no external backend: instruction.md:13 agrees with integration.md:3-14 and hireops_rules.md:197-201. (d) 15-second propagation: instruction.md:5 'fifteen seconds' = hireops_rules.md:117 '15 seconds'. (e) Candidate wording, page size 30, interview limits (2-3, within 1-50), and the seeded rejected card (rejected_from + reject_reason) agree with hireops_rules.md:61-65,144,182-189,205-208. (f) Undo: instruction.md:3 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' is refined, not contradicted, by hireops_rules.md:98-99 ('moved, re-ordered, rejected or reopened since ... Adding a note does not count as a change'); the brief explicitly says to read the rules alongside it (instruction.md:11). (g) Undo also refused when it would overfill Interview (rules:99) is an added constraint, not a conflict. No clock is stated anywhere, so there are no two clock values. Minor formatting artifacts in hireops_rules.md (lines 91, 99, 112, 173 break the ~104-column hard wrap used elsewhere) show later edits but contain no stray text and do not change meaning; not a defect under this row. Adversarial probes: a broken app cannot exploit this row (it grades the brief, not the app); a conforming app could be failed only if the brief contradicted itself, and no such contradiction was found. Mechanical half belongs to check-instruction-hygiene.py/check-instruction-content.py in the deterministic review; this verdict is a manual source review, not a checker run.
